description: A triage brief, rendered and written to the run directory. Nothing was sent to a model or to the forge.

brief.description: The brief, brief.md in the run directory, as an absolute path.

prefix_bytes.description: The length of the run-constant prefix of the brief: the mandate, the skill, the repository map and the report.

prefix_sha256.description: The hex SHA-256 of the prefix. It is the same for two briefs over the same tree and the same report, whatever the run, the answers or the brain.

document_bytes.description: The length of the whole brief, the task block included.

estimated_tokens.description: The size of the brief in tokens, estimated as its bytes divided by 4, rounded up.

map.description: How much of the repository map the brief holds.

level.description: The level of the map's ladder that fits its budget; 1 is every declaration.

report_truncated.description: True when the report was cut at 131072 bytes in the brief.

previous_question.description: True when an earlier run's question, which the --context answers, was found and is in the task block.
